title: Mixed Event — On This Holy Night, I Sing — Episode7 SEKAI's Newest Member?!

meta.Event: On This Holy Night, I Sing
meta.Event Outline: For their second show for the Show Contest, Tsukasa and the rest of WxS are preparing a Christmas-themed musical! However, a prima donna with a voice powerful enough to shock even Nene stands in their path...! Curtains open for these two songstresses as they each put their pride on the line!

rows.Line: 3 days before the show
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Nene's running late.
I wonder where she is...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For now let's just get everything ready. We can't start without her anyway...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's right. Her singing is central to this show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But we can't force this on her. She needs to find her own way.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, if she decides to quit, I'll do both roles and be a double lead!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's not beyond a star like myself to pull that off... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hello!!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yikes! Y-You could give us some kind of warning, you know!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hi, Miku♪ You came to see us again!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I couldn't get Nene out of my mind, so I dropped by to check in on her... Whoa!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hi, everyone! How are things going with your show?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wah! Another one?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <It's nice to meet you all! I'm MEIKO, the new arrival in SEKAI. We're doing a Christmas show and were hoping you'd all come and see it!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! You're the new member Miku was talking about...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yup, that's her! Although, I wasn't expecting her to follow me here...!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Miku told me one of your friends isn't doing well, and I couldn't just sit and wait. I thought our show might help cheer her up.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Let's get you all in a jolly mood with our Christmas show♪>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <So, where is she?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Morning... Sorry I'm so late.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There she is!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Nene, do you know what time it is?
Nevermind. How are you feeling today...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making you worry. I'm fine now. I've been practicing since morning and am ready for anything.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And now, I can sing like I used to... From my heart.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I knew you had it in you, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah. I expected no less of our heroine.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <It looks like you didn't need any encouragement from us after all!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh? You must be... MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <That's right! But enough about me... I just came by to make sure you were okay, so I'm happy to see you're back in high spirits!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Me too! It's a weight off my mind to see you've overcome your slump.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you both. And Miku... I'm sorry for being so rude by turning down your invitation the other day.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
If it still stands, I'd love to come and...
Maybe even be in your show too?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <What?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'd like to sing for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Of course you can! Everybody's welcome! All of you can join us on stage!>
bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Len, could you hang this decoration up there for me? That should be the last one, and be careful not to fall...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Okay! Aaand there, done!
Whoa... Y-Yikes...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Len, watch out!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oww... Huh? Wait, I'm not hurt?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You should be more careful, Len.
Lucky I caught you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks, MEIKO! I owe you one!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We've finally finished putting up the decorations.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Putting that huge Christmas tree in the middle of the stage was the right call. It's really eye-catching!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha, I have a feeling that things are only going to get livelier with you here!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then how's about we do our show right now? Look who I brought with me!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Great! You all came this time!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And I see that your show is ready to go as well.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah!
We can start whenever!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I um... About that...
I have a favor to ask...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Nene wants to sing with us. Would that be okay with everyone?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-I can finally sing from my heart again, and I was hoping you'd give it a listen...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, p-please...! Let me sing with you!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course, we'd like that very much!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We could sing the opening song together. We'll need four people for this, so Nene, KAITO, myself and one more...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rui, would you like to sing with us?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'd like that too. We can sing just like we did in the old days.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. If that is your wish, how can I say no?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Great! Are you ready to begin?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I love theater.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So I won't worry about making mistakes or beating our rivals at the contest anymore...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I just need to sing my heart out!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wooow!!
That was amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hahaha! That's the heroine of Wonderlands×Showtime for you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. It's been a long time since I heard Nene sing like that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Looks like you didn't need our help at all this time♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Miku, I want to sing too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course! Everyone will get to sing! Let's raise the curtain for our dazzling Christmas show!
